verdict.rationale: The only evidence of API versioning is a documented MCP endpoint path that carries a version segment (/v3). Nothing in the pack describes a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or version-lifecycle guarantees. Missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, versioning scheme documentation, changelog or migration guidance, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
